page.overview:
What is Fetch?

is the main antagonist of the first story of the same name from Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch of the Fazbear Frights series. He appears in a secret minigame in Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit.

Fetch is an animatronic dog about the size of a beagle. He has a large head shaped like a triangle, pointy on the top with a very wide mouth full of sharp, metal teeth at the bottom. Fetch has big pointed ears, a sloped forehead, a long snout with a big nose, and piercing yellow eyes. His matted grayish-brown fur is missing in places, revealing tarnished metal underneath. A couple of wires stick out of Fetch's ears, and a partially exposed hole in his belly reveals a primitive circuit board. Under his belly is a panel. Fetch wears a blue collar around his neck with a dog tag reading "Fetch."

The illustration and cover art shows Fetch as a light-brown animatronic dog, with big nose and some freckles on his snout, mouth filled with sharp teeth, and black eyes with orange irises. He wears a black collar. He is also noticeably not withered.

In Into the Pit, Fetch seems to be completely metallic. He also sports a blue "visor".
